question: Who among the following players received the Arjuna Award for the year 2001?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parminder Singh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Parminder Singh received the Arjuna Award for the year 2001.**
 
• He is a former Indian hockey player who played as a midfielder.
 
• He was a part of the Indian team that won the gold medal at the 2002 Asian Games held in Busan, South Korea.
 
• He was also a member of the Indian team that won the silver medal at the 2002 Commonwealth Games held in Manchester, England.
 
• Prashanti Singh is a former Indian women's basketball player who received the Arjuna Award in 2019.
 
• Sarabjeet Singh is a former Indian hockey player who received the Arjuna Award in 1995.
 
• Manmohan Singh Lodhi is a former Indian kabaddi player who received the Arjuna Award in 2003.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Arjuna Award in India is given for outstanding performance in sports.
 
• Arjuna Award 
 
 
• It is the second-highest sporting honor in India, the highest being the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award.
 
• The award is named after Arjuna, one of the characters of the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata of ancient India.
 
• Since the year 2001, the award is given only in disciplines falling under the following categories:
 
 
• ​Olympic Games / Asian Games / Commonwealth Games / World Cup / World Championship Disciplines and Cricket Indigenous Games.
 
• Sports for the Physically Challenged.
 
 
 
 
 
• Some important Arjuna Awards winners in 2021 are:
 
 
• Arpinder Singh - Athletics
 
• Simranjit Kaur - Boxing
 
• Shikhar Dhawan - Cricket
 
• Bhavani D. C. A. Sundhararaman - Fencing
